column1: Jake McCarthy leads off for Colorado at home with a strong track record of consistency, hitting safely in nearly 73% of games and benefiting from a favorable park and platoon edge against Andre Pallante. Alec Burleson also draws a soft matchup in the same hitter-friendly environment, but his recent form lags behind. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Otto Lopez offer steady volume atop their lineups, though McCarthy’s reliability and situational advantages set him apart as the top pick today.
